gaps: National climatic/resource indicators are not treated as local vulnerability rankings. Eastern Poland institutional capacity is not an FCV classification.
No complete supported climate–FCV chain is assembled; historic flood impacts, municipal adaptation and implementation constraints remain distinct from violence/conflict claims.

executive_assessment.text: Named Wielkopolska water-retention projects and Bydgoszcz/Gdańsk/Katowice cases give local adaptation detail; the national 2025 climate summary and preliminary 2024 flood counts retain their distinct scopes and vintages.
Eastern Poland project targeting and staffing constraints add institutional depth. Funding, legal deadlines and policy judgments are not verified uptake, completion or climate-conflict evidence.
